answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37458 Country: India Title: I am giving you some names. Please tell me their meanings and are they authentic Islamic names Question: I am giving you some names. Please tell me their meanings and are they authentic Islamic names? Alisha, Aleeza, Alina, Jasmin, Saara, Sophia. Answer ID: 37458 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 516/516/M=1433) Alisa (عليثه) means the bread of wheat and barley. We could not find any word like Alisha (عليشه). Alija (عليجه) means strong and solid. Jasmin (جاسمين) means hefty and heavyweight. Sarah (ساره) means pleasurable. Sofia (صوفيه) means pious and virtuous. These are Muslim names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
